subsystems.name: Compute array
subsystems.role: performs the matrix-vector multiplies that generate each token

subsystems.name: On-chip memory
subsystems.role: holds model weights and activations close to compute to avoid external memory bottlenecks

subsystems.name: Interconnect
subsystems.role: moves data between compute cores and memory at very high bandwidth

subsystems.name: Host interface
subsystems.role: connects the accelerator to a server CPU

subsystems.name: Software stack
subsystems.role: compiles and schedules models for the deterministic architecture

subsystems.name: Thermal and power delivery
subsystems.role: keeps the chip within temperature and power limits

buildSteps.title: Define the architecture
buildSteps.detail: Designers choose how many compute units, how much SRAM, and how data flows, targeting the memory bandwidth needed for token-by-token generation.

buildSteps.title: Write and verify RTL
buildSteps.detail: The design is described in a hardware description language and simulated to check correctness.

buildSteps.title: Physical design
buildSteps.detail: The netlist is placed and routed on a chosen process node, with timing and power closure.

buildSteps.title: Tape-out and fabrication
buildSteps.detail: Masks are made and wafers are fabricated in a semiconductor foundry, typically at 14 nm or 7 nm.

buildSteps.title: Packaging and test
buildSteps.detail: Dies are packaged, tested for speed and defects, and binned.

buildSteps.title: Board integration
buildSteps.detail: The chip is mounted on a card with power delivery, host interface and cooling.

buildSteps.title: Compiler and runtime development
buildSteps.detail: Software maps neural network graphs onto the chip's fixed dataflow, quantizing weights to fit on-chip memory.

buildSteps.title: Deployment in data centres
buildSteps.detail: Cards are installed in servers and exposed as inference endpoints, often via a cloud API.

prerequisites.why: chips with large on-chip SRAM require a suitable process node with high yield.
storing model weights on-chip demands many megabytes of fast SRAM.
reducing weight precision lets larger models fit in limited on-chip memory.
mapping models to a fixed dataflow requires sophisticated scheduling.
PCIe or similar links move prompts and results between CPU and accelerator.

pathway.unlocks: very low latency token generation for chatbots and real-time applications.

pathway.milestone: chips with larger on-chip memory to run bigger models without splitting across multiple chips
pathway.unlocks: higher quality models at low latency.

pathway.milestone: heterogeneous systems mixing LPUs with GPUs
pathway.unlocks: efficient handling of both prefill (parallel) and decode (sequential) phases.
private, offline LLM assistants in phones and laptops.
